newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Barlow slips, busy on disappointing results.
newsitem.headline: Barlow slips, busy on disappointing results.

text.p: Shares in industrial holding firm, Barlow Ltd, dipped in active morning dealings following below-expectation half year results released on Monday, dealers said.
By 0922 GMT Barlow was trading 45 cents weaker at 48.40 rand, its lowest level in four weeks, after posting pre-exceptional earnings per share of 145.4 cents, up a slim two percent from 142.5 before.
"The results were a litte bit disappointing...The biggest fright was from the local operations," a dealer said.
Barlow said on Monday that local business had been hardhit by lower margins and expressed disappointment at the lack of implementation of much-needed public sector fixed investment programmes.
However, better performances were seen from its offshore operations.
Dealers said a foreign deal in 23,000 Barlows share had taken place overnight at a level above 49 rand. It was, however, difficult to determine whether it was a sale or purchase.
